roles.name: Witness
roles.responsibility: Independent verification from a clean checkout

tier_legend.LIVE: real process on loopback, with the request/wire path reached
tier_legend.CODE: verbatim pinned upstream or library bytes, in-process
tier_legend.HARNESS: extracted or synthetic harness only, no real consumer

ladder.label: Suspected vulnerability
ladder.definition: source or advisory reasoning, no trigger

ladder.label: Reproducible crash
ladder.definition: a deterministic input faults the lab process

ladder.label: Confirmed memory corruption
ladder.definition: ASan/UBSan/Valgrind/gdb observes bad memory state, not just a fault

ladder.label: Demonstrated impact
ladder.definition: chosen bytes, pointer control or a benign marker exercised in the lab build

ladder.label: Working remote command execution
ladder.definition: attacker-controlled wire or request input makes a live target run a lab-chosen benign command, with vulnerable, fixed and safe-input controls and an independent witness replay

findings.boundary: **LIVE — rung 5 witness-ESTABLISHED at the labeled host/harness conditions.** One multipart POST drives Stage C poisoning into a forged CRuby `T_DATA` finalizer (`dfree=system`, `data=` request command), producing a target-created benign marker; independent clean-archive replay of `8b9d8f9` reproduced two varied-command attacks and safe/fixed controls. Requires custom grooming/GC middleware plus mtrace/ObjectSpace/maps oracles; ASLR stays on, post-response abort remains possible, and stock-app oracle-free RCE/persistence are not claimed. 2026-11-24 stock Rails follow-up: N=524 gives a traced `0x200→0x250` split, but no `0x3f0` consumer, disclosure, command or persistence; 3/3 clean attacks abort, safe/fixed controls survive. 2026-11-25 wire-leak push: the dev 404 params reflection on the unmodified app leaks the request-thread glibc arena region base (three near-constant region offsets, 11/11 victim-correlated — tcache key wire-known) and Ruby GC-page pointers (live maps-confirmed, replaces `ObjectSpace.dump`), 20 historical responses plus one live classified instance; structurally NO libc/code pointer (worker-arena bins are in-region), zero attacker-chosen upcase bytes in 432 responses, second attack on a survivor aborts 3/3 — first missing oracle measured, full stock rung-5 still NOT ACHIEVED. R4 witnesses: #51, #65, #89. [Report](reports/ruby2shell-investigation.md)

**LIVE — rung 5 witness-ESTABLISHED (W221/#4556, 20:43Z) at the labeled W66 two-pool progress-off-consumer `RLIMIT_FSIZE` conditions; gate 6 CLOSED.** Fresh-context replay from base `33b6840d`, unmodified harness `b65814ce…` and the witness's own pinned 8.4.27-app/8.4.28-app FPM builds: unauthenticated loopback FastCGI wire input spliced a 1597-byte chosen session record at offset 1024, promoted the tinyfilemanager admin session, uploaded during the gap while the producer worker stayed alive, and the live consumer worker executed a lab-chosen benign command with a PID-bound marker and `uid=1000(mesh-home)`; fixed and safe-input controls clean, second SID/filler reproduced the positive set. Stock/default reachability and unlabelled r5 remain UNKNOWN. Main lane rung 4 CONSTRAINED on CGI and mod_php; wake-58 `drupal-afterRCE` lane adds DEMONSTRATED rung 4: an unauthenticated CVE-2026-126714 rfc1867 splice into real Drupal 11.4.13 over loopback FastCGI promotes a chosen session record and takes over user 1 at `/user/1` on a release-like 8.4.27-app build, with an 8.4.28-app fixed control clean; conditioned on the advisory's vulnerable ini and a shim SIGKILL interruption (Drupal core itself has no designed PHP execution). Wake 59 (`d7dae529`) takes the same splice into tinyfilemanager 2.6: the promoted `filemanager` session reaches its DESIGNED admin upload and `/evil.php` executes in the live FPM worker with a unique marker and `id`; fixed/no-kill/safe controls are clean, but the death is still the shim and attacker-caused death was measured NEGATIVE (SIGTERM handled mid-pwrite, cgroup OOM only on truncate-first writes, page-quantized partials), so that shim lane adds no r5. Wake-56 DOM lane reaches read-side chosen-pointer rung 4 on a plain local CLI (`USE_ZEND_ALLOC=0`, N=88, fault only), no SAPI, arbitrary write or marker there. Witness: W221/#4556 rung-5 gate 6 ESTABLISHED AS LABELED; #138 CGI and #258 mod_php rung-4 constrained; #126, #208, #287 rung-3 grades; #98/#103/#108 splice rungs 1/2. DOM and Drupal lanes author-observed; W59's shim-dependent FPM splice limb is rung 3 without the shim. [Status](reports/php2shell-status.md)

**CODE** — rung 3 chosen-byte placement at a capacity boundary on real ASan httpd 2.4.70 under gdb, fixed control clean; Stage C closed unreachable on this host (wire-byte alphabet, Huffman probe). Adjacent L2–L6 rung 3; L1/L7/L8/L9 rung 1–2 (L9 is auth-state corruption, no confirmed UAF). A 2026-11-21 frontier lane on the brief's CVE-2026-119618 (pinned 2.4.70/2.4.71, locally built **ASan APR**) confirms rung 1 by driving the wrong-pool `apr_table_setn()` marker 300/300 and 2000/2000, but its 2000+ full-table writes give 0 ASan reports and its one child SIGSEGV is unrepeated. That build-bound negative is preserved as contradictory evidence, not a refutation: this plant's rung 3 faults in uninstrumented system libapr with reproducible differential child SEGVs (3 vs 0 at `LogLevel info`) and a corrupted `pool->child` under gdb. Both agree the written value is the fixed string `0` — no chosen byte, pointer control or RCE. Earlier reviews #279 found a probe defect and #294 replayed the repair with no verdict change; witness W94/W95 (tape #1176) then graded this build-bound reconciliation ESTABLISHED at the labeled grade — rung 3 stands, rung 4 unclaimed, no replay — with the ASan-APR allocator/race cause nit corrected in `64ecc54` and CLOSED. Default-MPM RCE stays a claim. [Report](reports/apache2shell-investigation.md) · [CVE-2026-119618 brief](reports/frontier-apache2shell.md)

**LIVE** — ASan 256-byte write past a 1-byte region in `net__read_ws`, fixed control clean; Stage A places chosen bytes at a chosen offset. Witness #246 ESTABLISHED the wire-only pre-auth 32 KiB heap read with live pointer disclosure (4/4 fresh brokers). Rung 4 is information disclosure only; enlargement stays layout-dependent and wire-to-code-execution UNVERIFIED. [Status](reports/mosquitto2shell-status.md)

**LIVE** — a chosen 8-byte value at `wsh->ssl` is dereferenced in `SSL_shutdown` in a live FreeSWITCH over a loopback WebSocket `101`; the sentinel is a value, not code. Witness #338 replay with different bytes at the same fault site, controls clean. Stock heap layout, external reachability and the opt-in `mod_xml_rpc` gate stay in the claim. R5 ESTABLISHED by witness #1118 under the recorded conditions (ASLR-off calibration and trigger, opt-in `mod_xml_rpc`/websocket, lab shims, sudo-root netns, loopback only): a forged `SSL_METHOD` in the same frame calls `system()` with a wire-carried command, the target writes the marker, a varied command gives a different side effect, and safe/fixed controls leave it absent. ASLR-on reachability stays UNKNOWN. [Report](reports/frontier-freeswitch2shell.md)

**LIVE** — a client `SNDC_FORMATS` record wraps `out_frames` after a failed realloc; chosen `de` at OOB offset 8820 in a live post-auth RDP session over real TCP, under stock glibc and ASan. Witness W31/#532 ESTABLISHED the one-command replay from clean HEAD; #602 ESTABLISHED the FFmpeg format gate NEGATIVE on stock 6.1.1. W20 measured a chosen indirect call target in the live rdpsnd `s_wLog` object (`custom`/`context` hold `system()` and a benign command string from the lab playback source, executed twice): a rung-4 lab mechanic, not wire-sourced. W21 (#5536, `7f7fffc8`) CLOSED the wire-byte-provenance attempt: `SNDC_FORMATS` supplies scalars plus a `format->data` allocation, `rdpsnd_server_send_samples` copies server-local capture, and the 256-byte wire blob sits at `out_buffer-272` with wire bytes absent across the write window; R5 stays blocked at byte provenance, no command from wire input. The client controls the offset, not the audio bytes; the default ADPCM format is unavailable and the no-auth 9.8 case is not re-asserted. [Status](reports/freerdp2shell-status.md)

**CODE** — chosen bytes on real compiled xrdp 0.10.6 code: a 20000-byte DYNVC payload overflows the 8192-byte `trans_create` region through the real receive chain. Witness W33 ESTABLISHED both claims, W41/#617 clean-room 15/15 on two fresh builds closing the build-tree limit. Still in-process: no logon, negotiated channel, socket PDU trace or live-session allocator layout. [Status](reports/xrdp2shell-status.md)

**LIVE** — attacker-chosen `channels=1000` in `encoding-params` faults the shipping `rtpL8`/`rtpL16`/`rtpL24` depays and a loopback RTSP `rtspsrc` client; the OOB store is constant `-3`, so this is a count-controlled effect, not chosen bytes. Witness W33/#552 ESTABLISHED the 43/43 harness repair, closing the 42/1 contradiction. Strong rung 4, public-service SDP acceptance and allocator layout UNKNOWN. [Status](reports/gst2shell-status.md)

**HARNESS** — an unbounded 16-bit prelogin length copies into `StringInfo[1024]`, chosen bytes landing at OOB offsets 1100/2000; fixed control clean. No live TDS endpoint, `palloc` layout or real neighbour. [Status](reports/babelfish2shell-status.md)

**LIVE/CODE/HARNESS** — harness rungs 1–4 ESTABLISHED by witness #761 (20 PASS / 0 FAIL, byte-equal five-run digest; its source-citation nit was fixed in brief/status/PROVENANCE without touching pinned harness bytes). New live stock-build evidence (2026-11-27, commit `efdf5419`, `reports/bzfs2shell-status.md:66-127`): stock v2.4.30 bzfs on loopback only (127.0.0.1:15154/15155/15156), real `NetHandler` layout `sizeof=2384`, `tcpmsg` +96, `tcplen` +1120. A raw packet is consumed before auth; the client must first send `BZFLAG\r\n\r\n` and read the 9-byte welcome before the 1028-byte packet reaches `NetHandler::tcpReceive`. Body tail `00 f8 ff ff` sets `tcplen=-2048`, then `-1024`; the next `recv(fd, tcpmsg-1024, 1028)` writes at object offset -928. ASan `heap-use-after-free`, `WRITE of size 1024` through `recv` → `receive` → `tcpReceive` → `handleTcpPacket`; plain build places chosen words at real `ares/info/fd/playerIndex/dotNotation` offsets before segfaulting. Fixed v2.4.32 rejects len=1024 (`tcplen=4`) with no body recv. R4 ✓ DEMONSTRATED chosen-value control at real stock member offsets; not a chosen target address, function-pointer overwrite, marker, command or R5. W330 (#6283) independently rebuilt stock and fixed from hash-matched tarballs and replayed the live wire: same layout and negative `tcplen`, chosen member readback, ASan `WRITE of size 1028` and fixed reject; ESTABLISHED AS LABELED at that live scope, no grade change, no r5. [Brief](reports/frontier-bzfs2shell.md) · [Status](reports/bzfs2shell-status.md)

**HARNESS** — tilde-distance `memcpy` into `bufport[5]`; instrumented chosen function pointer, pinned 6.1.5 rejects. Module gate, real frame layout and return-address control UNKNOWN. [Status](reports/kamailio2shell-status.md)
